name: Pattaya
tagline: Large-scale convention halls & seaside entertainment meets
intro: Home to PEACH (Pattaya Exhibition and Convention Hall), beachfront resorts, and vibrant offsite team celebration venues.
access: Flights from Delhi to Bangkok, then about two hours by road.
highlights: Beach resorts with large banquet capacity at a lower cost per delegate than most Indian beach destinations.
Usually paired with a night or two in Bangkok, so one trip covers a working session and a reward leg.
Suits dealer and channel-partner trips where scale and perceived value matter more than exclusivity.
planning_note: Property standards vary more here than almost anywhere else on this list. The specific hotel matters far more than the destination, so do not sign off on a category alone.
